correct_completion: was a detailed report on the project's progress.
full_sentence: What the manager really wanted was a detailed report on the project's progress.
acceptable_variants: was a clear summary of the project's progress.
was an update on how the project was going.

options.why_wrong: The pseudo-cleft structure needs 'was' before the focus; without it the sentence is broken.

options.text: was a detailed report on the project's progress.
did the team finish the project early.
options.why_wrong: This is a question, but a pseudo-cleft needs a declarative focus after 'was'.

options.text: the team finished early and the budget grew.
options.why_wrong: There is no 'was' to introduce the focus, so the pseudo-cleft structure does not work.

explanation: A pseudo-cleft sentence begins with 'What' plus a clause, then 'was' before the focus. Learners often leave out 'was' or use a plain clause instead, which breaks the structure.
translation: Те, чого менеджер справді хотів, — це детальний звіт про хід проєкту.
